test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

A study of metaphysics is the study of the nature of realty, of what exists in the world, what it is like and how it is ordered.
solution:
The correct answer is __**realty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **Realty**.
 
• The correct spelling would **Reality**.
 
• The word **reality **means the actual state of things, as opposed to an idealistic or fictitious conception of them..
 
• *Example *: You have to face **reality **at the end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Metaphysics **means The branch of philosophy concerned with the fundamental principles of things, such as being, knowing, identity, time, and space.

*Example *: They would consider the question of the universe's initial conditions to be a matter of **metaphysics **or religion.

 
• The word **Study** means the devoting of time and attention to acquiring knowledge of an academic subject, particularly through the use of books

*Example *: I need to **study **mathematics today.

 
• The word **nature **means the phenomena of the physical world as a whole, including plants, animals, the landscape, and other earthly features and products, as opposed to humans or human creations

*Example *: The **nature **is so beautiful.
